title: Uniformity of interpretation.
bodyText: This chapter shall be so interpreted and construed as to effectuate its general purpose to make uniform the law of those states which enact it.
bodyHtml: [§636C-8]  Uniformity of interpretation.  This chapter shall be so interpreted and construed as to effectuate its general purpose to make uniform the law of those states which enact it. [L 1983, c 31, pt of §1]
